mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT MENU_ID) AS "total" FROM PERMISSIONS WHERE STATUS = '01' AND MENU_ID IS NOT NULL

SELECT MENU_ID AS "menuId" , MENU_NAME AS "menuName" , COUNT(PERMISSION_ID) AS "permissionCount" FROM PERMISSIONS WHERE STATUS = '01' AND MENU_ID IS NOT NULL GROUP BY MENU_ID , MENU_NAME ORDER BY MENU_ID LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.MENU_ID) AS "total" FROM ROLE_PERMISSIONS RP JOIN PERMISSIONS P ON P.PERMISSION_ID = RP.PERMISSION_ID WHERE RP.ROLE_ID = #{roleId} AND P.STATUS = '01' AND P.MENU_ID IS NOT NULL

SELECT P.MENU_ID AS "menuId" , P.MENU_NAME AS "menuName" , COUNT(P.PERMISSION_ID) AS "permissionCount" FROM ROLE_PERMISSIONS RP JOIN PERMISSIONS P ON P.PERMISSION_ID = RP.PERMISSION_ID WHERE RP.ROLE_ID = #{roleId} AND P.STATUS = '01' AND P.MENU_ID IS NOT NULL GROUP BY P.MENU_ID , P.MENU_NAME ORDER BY P.MENU_ID LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) AS "total" FROM PERMISSIONS WHERE MENU_ID = #{menuId} AND STATUS = '01' AND (NULLIF(#{permissionId}, '') IS NULL OR PERMISSION_ID ILIKE '%' || #{permissionId} || '%')

SELECT PERMISSION_ID AS "permissionId" , NAME AS "name" , REMARK AS "description" , MENU_ID AS "menuId" , MENU_NAME AS "menuName" FROM PERMISSIONS WHERE MENU_ID = #{menuId} AND STATUS = '01' AND (NULLIF(#{permissionId}, '') IS NULL OR PERMISSION_ID ILIKE '%' || #{permissionId} || '%') ORDER BY PERMISSION_ID LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "total" FROM ROLE_PERMISSIONS RP JOIN PERMISSIONS P ON P.PERMISSION_ID = RP.PERMISSION_ID WHERE RP.ROLE_ID = #{roleId} AND P.MENU_ID = #{menuId} AND P.STATUS = '01' AND (NULLIF(#{permissionId}, '') IS NULL OR P.PERMISSION_ID ILIKE '%' || #{permissionId} || '%')

SELECT P.PERMISSION_ID AS "permissionId" , P.NAME AS "name" , P.REMARK AS "description" , P.MENU_ID AS "menuId" , P.MENU_NAME AS "menuName" FROM ROLE_PERMISSIONS RP JOIN PERMISSIONS P ON P.PERMISSION_ID = RP.PERMISSION_ID WHERE RP.ROLE_ID = #{roleId} AND P.MENU_ID = #{menuId} AND P.STATUS = '01' AND (NULLIF(#{permissionId}, '') IS NULL OR P.PERMISSION_ID ILIKE '%' || #{permissionId} || '%') ORDER BY P.PERMISSION_ID LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ROLE_PERMISSIONS ( ROLE_ID, PERMISSION_ID, PROCESS_TIMESTAMP, STATUS, FIRST_REGISTER_BRANCH, FIRST_REGISTER_USER, FIRST_REGISTER_DATE, FIRST_REGISTER_TIME, LAST_CHANGE_BRANCH, LAST_CHANGE_USER, LAST_CHANGE_DATE, LAST_CHANGE_TIME ) VALUES ( #{roleId}, #{permissionId}, COALESCE(#{processTimestamp}, now()), COALESCE(#{status}, '01'), #{firstRegisterBranch}, #{firstRegisterUser}, #{firstRegisterDate}, #{firstRegisterTime}, #{lastChangeBranch}, #{lastChangeUser}, #{lastChangeDate}, #{lastChangeTime} ) ON CONFLICT (ROLE_ID, PERMISSION_ID) DO NOTHING
